reviews.title: Great but the update
reviews.text: Really enjoy the game but the most recent update changed how the questions are weighted. It used to be you were given 6 questions and a bonus question. That way whatever your score was based on the 6 questions you had the bonus question to boost it but if you got it wrong and it would not count against your final score. Now with the update, if you get the bonus wrong it counts against you which defeats the purpose of a ‘bonus’ question. You might as well just have 7 questions and don’t call the last one a bonus. Fix that and you earn the last star. Cheers

reviews.title: Too many errors
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing the game for a couple months now, and have added a bunch of optional categories.  These newer categories have a significant number of typos- spelling mistakes, words not capitalized, and one question was missing a fourth answer.  

I like the game in general, and it plays quickly enough, but in some cases the wrong answers (distractors)  are so stupid, it’s insulting.  I have found a few questions, though not many, with wrong answers.

It appears that in the haste to add categories,  the editing was lacking.

reviews.title: Lose the gimmicks, or allow us to end them
reviews.text: This game can be very fun to play. Unfortunately, it has gotten less so with all the dumb gimmicks. Fine for many, but not for all. I just want to play the game and answer questions. I hate all the nonsense all over the screen that spin and blink and rotate and flash. There should be a setting that allows us to turn all that off so we can just play the game. The ads already get in the way. Now all that other junk cluttering up the screen does, too. At this rate, I will never update the game again, as each update causes more needless, gimmicky garbage to get in the way of the actual game.

reviews.title: New categories and price
reviews.text: I like this trivia app for questions and not many repeats. But all of a sudden, ads pop up way more?! And my one biggest complaint before was I wished they did more trivia categories. Needless to say, I got excited when I saw the recently added 30-40 new categories. Of course, “for purchase” ugh. I’m down to pay for the app, but it costs 1,000 jewels to play one new category. To buy 500 jewels, cost $10. So if you want to be able to just play any of the new categories, it would cost $20 per one category (1,000 jewels). For all 30 - 40 new categories, would cost $600-$800! Most apps just do one annual subscription which is fine- at like $20-$50 one time purchase. I would pay that, but then should get to play any category. Maybe I’m wrong and there’s a way to just do one annual purchase for all categories? If so, let me know and I’ll update my review.
